description: April 16, 2026 Thanks to everyone that came out for our Statewide convention last Saturday. It was a huge success! It was very gratifying to see the hundreds of people that attended. I remember just three short years ago when we had around 20 people in attendance. Our guest speaker was Andrew Yang. He gave us a brief history of the party and his vision for the future.
